# Zam Zam Automatic Door Repairs

> Automatic door, garage door, security gate, and industrial door supplier and installer serving Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, and the wider UAE and GCC.

Zam Zam Door supplies, installs, and maintains automatic door systems for residential, commercial, and industrial clients. Services include installation, repair, maintenance, and 24/7 emergency support, with free site visits.

## Products & Services

- [Automatic Doors](https://www.zamzamdoor.com/automatic-doors): Sliding, swing, folding, revolving, and glass automatic doors.
- [Garage Doors](https://www.zamzamdoor.com/garage-doors): Residential and commercial sectional garage doors with DoorHan automatic operators.
- [Security Gates](https://www.zamzamdoor.com/security-gates): Automatic gates, boom barriers, and turnstile access control.
- [Industrial Doors](https://www.zamzamdoor.com/industrial-doors): Roller shutters, high-speed doors, and loading dock equipment.
